bugs.what: Quest-hint directions (e.g. 'ask in Reedholm, then out onto the fen: two stands west, then in') didn't match the actual room-exit labels needed to reach the location; the real path required going east from Fenmarch Causeway through several unlabeled rooms, not 'west' as the hint implied.
Two nearly-identically named rooms exist in different territories ('The Fen Causeway' near the Vale gate vs 'Fenmarch Causeway' deeper in), which is easy to conflate when mentally mapping the region.

confusions: Spent ~30 turns blindly exploring Fenmarch's side-rooms trying to find 'the drowned nave' because the quest-log direction hint didn't correspond to the actual exit chain from Reedholm.
No in-fiction compass or 'head toward quest' shortcut, so multi-room quest destinations sometimes required brute-force checking every unexplored exit in a hub.
suggestions: Make quest-hint directions match the exact cardinal exits a player would actually take from the named starting room, or phrase them relative to a landmark instead of dead-reckoning distances.
A free 'get bearings toward <active quest>' action (in addition to the existing free 'get your bearings') would cut down blind backtracking in large hub regions like Fenmarch/Hollowbrook.
The companion approval/dispute system, perk choices, and check-odds transparency were excellent and should be kept as-is — very clear at every decision point.
